scientific_integrity: Proof is analytical; a standalone exact rational finite-range checker is included for reproducibility. Computer checks do not establish the infinite-domain theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the full slope-two tent map, not arbitrary unimodal maps. Unfolding/over-rotation equality uses the published low-modality theorem. No claim of an independent audit or absolute publication priority is made.
title: Exact prime-cycle unfolding spectrum and Gaussian law for the full tent map
